== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Timer Mine (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Timer Mine]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/timer_mine__lightside_japanese_white_border/50625 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/0473a9bb63134ab49b7d80b26b7abd2a/IMG_20220607_0139.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(10, 6, 770, 1066)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>d5740775b627b6281468598b7825d1f81d483de3c46c02b5953f4afd825eb5ce</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
